correctness.rationale: For m>=2,n=2^m-1, m binary tests must map the n adjacent-pair defect sets bijectively to all nonzero m-bit masks (zero reserved for empty). Thus each bit is 1 in 2^(m-1) edge outcomes. Each selected vertex hits at most two cyclic edges, forcing pool cardinality >=2^(m-2). Equality forces no two selected vertices adjacent and all m pools have that cardinality. Explicit item masks a_i=i at even indices; 1 for i==1 mod4; 0 for i==3 mod4, yield edge OR labels 1..n exactly, independent pools of size 2^(m-2), so Wmin=m*2^(m-2). Independent integer reimplementation verified m=2..12, but universal proof is symbolic.
